Better Money Strike is the Bitcoin company. With Strike , you can buy and sell bitcoin, pay bills, and borrow against your holdings. From individuals to businesses, Strike is purpose-built for every step of the Bitcoin journey.

Available in more than 100 countries — including the U.S., Europe, Latin America, and Africa — Strike is building a better financial system powered by Bitcoin. Bitcoin is better money. Strike is how you use it. Role: Strike is where people around the world send, save, and spend money on bitcoin rails.

For a product like that, customer trust is a feature in and of itself.

As Trust Product Manager, you'll own the features that make customers confident keeping their money with Strike : account security controls, verified support experiences, beneficiary planning, account management, and the systems like KYC/B, transaction limits, account restrictions that keep fraudsters out without getting in the way of good customers.

You'll ship customer-facing features, and you'll own the foundations underneath them, turning what most companies treat as friction into experiences customers actually appreciate.

You'll succeed by shipping trust-building features customers love, minimizing fraud, maintaining compliance, and protecting the health and integrity of the Strike ecosystem. This position is available for candidates located in the eastern US time zone.

What You’ll Do: Serve as the voice of the customer (internal customer too!) and intimately understand the products we offer as well as their potential fraud vectors and blind spots Work closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Data to uncover and understand needs Partner with cross-functional peers to define, prioritize, and deliver a roadmap and product that maximize impact to financial risk management and our fraud strategy Own our Fraud KPIs and partner with Data and Finance to iterate on their definition as needed Establish and track success metrics for various features and initiatives, including operational efficiencies Support and motivate cross-functional teams through an inclusive and collaborative mindset Qualifications: At least 4 years of experience in product management, with at least 2 of those years in trust/fraud related teams A highly experimental mindset to drive innovation amidst uncertainty or ambiguity (e.g., new processes, teams, systems) Vast experience working with designers and user researchers Empathy to work with a diverse array of cross functional peers and stakeholders Resourcefulness, pragmatism and roll-up the sleeves mentality Excellent verbal and written communication skills Experience and interest for Bitcoin and Fintech is a plus US-Based Positions Salary range: $162K - 190K Equity in a high-growth startup Health, dental, and vision insurance premium contributions; short & long-term disability insurance and basic life insurance Cell phone and internet reimbursement Flexible PTO, sick leave & parental leave Access to a company 401k plan We do not make hiring decisions based on educational history whatsoever.

Our Founder is a college dropout. We employ high school dropouts, PHD candidates and everything in-between. We do not hire credentials. We simply hire talented, passionate individuals who are excited to be a part of our team.

By clicking submit application below, you consent to our use and processing of your data as described in our Candidate Privacy Notice . Originally posted on Himalayas

deine aufgaben: Bei chargecloud bauen wir das digitale Herzstück der europäischen Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge.

Unser cloudbasiertes Ökosystem – mit dem chargecloud Operating System im Zentrum, erweitert durch Whitelabel-Frontends und Partner-Services – ermöglicht es E-Mobility-Helden, ihr Lade-Business aufzubauen und zu skalieren, kWh für kWh. Zur Verstärkung unserer wachsenden Produktorganisation suchen wir eine:n Product Owner.

Dein zukünftiger Aufgabenbereich könnte nah an der Customer Experience, dem kommerziellen und finanziellen Rückgrat oder dem technischen und datenbasierten Fundament unserer Plattform liegen – die optimale Passform definieren wir gemeinsam im Recruiting-Prozess. Übernimm die volle Verantwortung für deinen Produktbereich – von der Discovery über die Delivery bis hin zu messbaren Ergebnissen Verantworte und pflege das Product Backlog und priorisiere eigenständig auf Basis von Produktstrategie, Kundennutzen sowie Aufwand/Risiko Betreibe kontinuierliche Product Discovery: Sprich regelmäßig mit Kunden sowie Nutzern, validiere Probleme und Lösungen frühzeitig und teste Konzepte, bevor du sie skalierst Definiere und verfeinere Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Engineering Leads und Stakeholdern; übersetze komplexe geschäftliche, regulatorische oder technische Themen in klare Deliverables und messbare Ergebnisse Pflege und kommuniziere eine ergebnisorientierte Roadmap, die Innovation, Kundenbedürfnisse und Plattformstabilität in Einklang bringt Nutze Daten und Produktmetriken, um Entscheidungen zu treffen, Erfolge zu messen und zu iterieren – nicht nur für das Reporting Arbeite in unserer Product-Development-Organisation und liefere iterativ neue Funktionen, während du bestehende kontinuierlich verbesserst das bist du: Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager in einem SaaS-Umfeld.

Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe Backlogs zu managen und zwischen geschäftlichen, kundenbezogenen und technischen Anforderungen zu vermitteln. Praktische Erfahrung mit modernen Methoden der Produktentwicklung – Continuous Discovery, iterative Delivery, ergebnisorientiertes Roadmapping und evidenzbasierte Priorisierung.

Du definierst Erfolgsmetriken, arbeitest mit Produktanalysen und lässt dich bei deinen Entscheidungen von Fakten und Daten leiten. Du nutzt schon heute aktiv KI-Tools in deiner täglichen Arbeit und denkst darüber nach, wie KI sowohl Produkte als auch Prozesse verbessern kann. Du verstehst, wie moderne Softwareplattformen funktionieren (z. B.

APIs, Integrationen, Cloud-Architekturen), und kannst in Diskussionen mit Engineers auf Augenhöhe argumentieren. Exzellente Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten gegenüber technischem und nicht-technischem Publikum.

Du sprichst fließend Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus. das bieten wir: Remote First: Ob Homeoffice, deutschlandweite Coworking Spaces oder moderne Zentrale in Köln – wir decken alle Arbeitsformen ab. Gut ausgestattet: Damit es dir im Homeoffice an nichts fehlt, stellen wir die passende Hardware zur Verfügung.

Nach der Probezeit erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für ergonomisches Arbeiten von zu Hause. Flexibilität: Bei uns kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten: Mit einer Kernarbeitszeit von 9:00 bis 12:00 Uhr hast du Freiraum, um Beruf und Privatleben entspannt zu vereinen.

Mit unserem Workation Worldwide Programm kannst du bis zu 60 Arbeitstage im Jahr ortsunabhängig arbeiten – jetzt weltweit innerhalb von ±4 Stunden zur deutschen Zeitzone.

Benefits à la carte: Mit Probonio gestaltest du deine Benefits jeden Monat neu: Nutze dein Budget für Essenszuschüsse, Kita-Zuschüsse, Gutscheine oder buche dein Urban Sports Club Abo – ganz flexibel per App. Erholung & Auszeit : Du profitierst von 32 Tagen bezahltem Urlaub pro Jahr.

Zusätzlich sind Heiligabend und Silvester bei uns komplett arbeitsfrei. Mit unserem Culture Day kannst du dir außerdem einen Tag freinehmen, der dir persönlich wichtig ist – ganz bewusst und individuell.

Unternehmensweiter Bonus: Unser Shared Success Plan fördert den gemeinsamen Fokus auf unsere Ziele, indem wir den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens transparent und fair mit allen teilen. Mobilität & Nachhaltigkeit: Über FINN JobAuto kannst du dein eigenes E-Fahrzeug zu attraktiven Konditionen leasen. Zusätzlich profitierst du von Bikeleasing.

Teamgeist: Unsere Teams treffen sich einmal im Tertial persönlich zu Brainstorming, Workshops und natürlich zu unseren beliebten Sommer- und Winterfeiern. Gesund im Job: Wir unterstützen dich mit Urban Sports Club, Life Coaching Programmen und weiteren Angeboten, damit du fit und stressfrei durch den Arbeitsalltag kommst.

Dog-F riendly Headquarters : Dein vierbeiniger Freund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen -- bring deinen Hund einfach mit zur Arbeit!

Und noch mehr: 20 % Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Zugang zu unserem attraktiven Rabattportal und viel Spaß(!) - "Spark joy together" ist nicht umsonst eine unserer Firmenwerte. art der beschäftigung Vollzeit, 40 Stunden, unbefristet lust teil des teams zu werden? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Alle Menschen sind bei uns willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht / geschlechtlicher Identität, Behinderung / Beeinträchtigung, Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion / Weltanschauung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung. Hauptsache, du passt zu uns. Originally posted on Himalayas

Agentic AI ist deine Welt – und du willst dich damit beschäftigen, statt ständig etwas verkaufen zu müssen?
Du hast dich intensiv mit KI-Agenten beschäftigt, eigene Workflows oder Anwendungen gebaut und kennst Themen wie n8n, Make, APIs, Tool Calling, RAG, Vektordatenbanken oder MCP aus der Praxis?
Dann bau mit uns den besten Agentic-AI-Kurs im deutschsprachigen Raum.
Aufgaben
Der Titel heißt Product Manager – gemeint ist aber jemand, der Lerninhalte baut, nichtverwaltet: halb Instructional Designer, halb Agentic-AI-Bastler. Du gestaltest das Produkt „Kurs“, von der ersten Demo bis zum fertigen Modul. Dabei beschäftigst du dich mit uns zusammen unter anderem mit folgenden Fragen:
Was müssen Menschen heute über Agentic AI wissen?
Welche Tools, Modelle und Frameworks sind wirklich relevant?
Welche Agenten und Automatisierungen sollten Teil des Kurses sein?
Wie lassen sich technische Inhalte verständlich und praxisnah vermitteln?
Welche Übungen, Projekte und Demos bringen Teilnehmer wirklich weiter?
Du unterstützt uns dabei, Inhalte zu strukturieren, praktische Anwendungen zu bauen, Lernmaterialien zu entwickeln und Referenten fachlich zu begleiten. Einzelne Inhalte kannst du später auch selbst unterrichten.
Qualifikation
Wir suchen keinen Verkäufer und keinen klassischen Bildungsmanager – sondern jemanden mit technischem Hintergrund, der bereits tief in Agentic AI steckt, neue Entwicklungen aufmerksam verfolgt und komplexe Dinge verständlich erklären kann.
Ob Berufseinsteiger mit starkem Portfolio oder mit ein paar Jahren Erfahrung in Content, Training oder Produktentwicklung – entscheidend ist, was du bereits gebaut oder vermittelt hast, nicht dein Titel.

Kleines Team, kurze Wege
Hybrides Arbeits-Setup: Büro in Berlin-Mitte + Homeoffice
Tägliche Arbeit mit den aktuellsten KI-Tools und -Entwicklungen
Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - du verwaltest nicht, du baust auf
Perspektive auf eine wachsende Rolle in einem wachsenden Bereich
Vollzeit, unbefristet.
Schick uns nicht nur deinen Lebenslauf – zeig uns, womit du dich beschäftigst und was du bereits gebaut oder entwickelt hast (z.B. Kurskonzepte, Workshops, Tutorials oder Prototypen)!

Who We Are We started our company to help others launch and run their own businesses, at any stage. The way we help is by keeping it simple and supporting entrepreneurs one step at a time. Put simply: our mission is to enable anyone to start, run, and grow their business while avoiding the common pitfalls that derail hopeful entrepreneurs.

No more having to wade through forms, taxes, or ongoing state compliance. We are a remote company based in Austin, Texas. We have team members from Florida to Oregon and all points in-between. Take pride in your work knowing that it shapes how people all across the country reach their goal of starting, running, and growing their business.

If the idea of helping people and working with a genuinely caring, supportive team excites you, then you’ve come to the right place. The Role We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the logged-in customer experience at ZenBusiness — the first experience a new business owner sees after signing up and starting to run their company.

This role is about everything that happens after completing their formation: how we keep them coming back, deepening the value they get from our product suite, and turning first-time customers into long-term relationships. You'll own the product roadmap for our native apps (iOS and Android) and web dashboard.

Your mandate is to create a unified, delightful, self-serve experience that helps business owners get more out of every ZenBusiness product they own — from formations and compliance to marketing and fintech — and to drive more awareness and attachment of our highest-value offerings they don’t yet own.

This is a high-visibility individual contributor role that reports directly to the VP of Product, Growth. Responsibilities Build a unified product experience with Velo at the center Define and drive the product roadmap for the logged-in Web & native app experiences, focused on engagement depth, repeat usage, and in-app monetization.

Partner with our Velo team to bring our AI business guide to the center of our logged in experience, leveraging the unique capabilities of our agentic platform to do more for our business owners.

Collaborate closely with the product managers who own our individual products — formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech — to bring the best of each into a single, coherent customer experience. Identify and run experiments to lift core engagement, retention, and product-attachment metrics.

Work cross-functionally with design, engineering, and marketing to execute against that vision. Drive usage and attachment of our highest-value products Drive activation across our product suite by directly leading activation initiatives and equipping other PMs with the tools to drive activation themselves.

If a customer paid for it, your job is to get them to use it. Drive higher activation and usage of our key formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech products by surfacing the right capability at the right moment.

Increase awareness and attachment of our highest-value products through thoughtful CTAs, cross-sell sequencing, and upsell entry points — without compromising the customer experience. Use experimentation and customer data to find friction in the purchase funnel and optimize conversion at every step.

Act as the primary Product point of contact across product marketing, customer success, finance, and other teams that contribute to increasing customer attach rate and retention.

Operate as a builder Use AI across the product lifecycle — research, ideation, prototyping, experiment design — with tools like Claude, Lovable, v0, and Replit as your default mode of working, not a one-off. Prototype your high-potential ideas and put them in front of real customers or internal users for rapid feedback and iteration.

Contribute to our product features that create real customer value — with the judgment to know where AI deepens the experience vs. where it's a distraction. What We're Looking For 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or senior PM level.

Proven track record owning mobile app products (iOS and/or Android) — you understand the platform, the patterns, and how to drive engagement on native surfaces. Demonstrated ability to design unified experiences across multiple products and partner closely with other PMs to make the whole greater than the sum of its parts.

Experience designing self-serve customer experiences with thoughtful escalation paths to human support. Strong instincts around monetization — you know how to position products, write CTAs, structure purchase flows, and find the friction that kills conversion.

Experience working across web and native apps simultaneously; you think in customer journeys, not platforms. Strong collaborator with design and engineering; you can drive decisions without authority. Comfortable in ambiguity — this role requires you to set direction, not execute someone else's roadmap.

Bonus: experience with AI-powered product features, SMB or subscription products, or growth experimentation. Why This Role Matters ZenBusiness serves over 1 million small business owners, and our product suite spans formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech.

This role exists to ensure that entrepreneurs can use ZenBusiness as their operating system to confidently grow their business. The dashboard and native app are where the ZenBusiness experience comes to life. Remote Culture. A great company culture leads to happy employees, and happy employees lead to happy customers.

We provide our employees with good salaries, benefits, equity, and interesting challenges that have a positive impact. Let’s stay connected! We believe in staying connected, and we have a weekly “All Hands” meeting every week. We also have a social committee that hosts frequent events.

We’ve held a virtual talent show, costume competitions, monthly lunch and learn series, Hackathons and more! Benefits. The company offers various benefits to employees and their dependents, including medical, vision, dental, disability, and life insurance, as well as parental and military leave.

Other benefits include an employee assistance program, 401k + match, annual bonus, pet insurance, and RSUs. Paid parking* and 10 paid holidays are also provided. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. We believe in diversity, equity & inclusion .

At ZenBusiness , every voice counts no matter your race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, location, or background. We celebrate the diversity of our teams, knowing that our products, services, and customers thrive best when we lean into and celebrate our differences.

Please check out our careers' page to learn more about our culture, benefits, and open opportunities. *applicable to in-office employees Originally posted on Himalayas

Who we are At Fluxon , we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through.

Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Open AI, Anthropic, Stripe, Walmart and Google. Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard.

We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do. Inside Fluxon , you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft.

We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here. Many of our team members call the Bay Area home, but this role is fully remote across North America.

About the role As a Product Manager at Fluxon , you’ll be the strategic driving force at the center of our team and a trusted partner to our customers. We’re looking for someone who craves having real impact and ownership.

While specific responsibilities may differ from project to project, you will: Develop expertise in a variety of customer domains such as AI, healthcare, SaaS, eCommerce, and many others Build deep partnerships with startups and tech leaders alike to understand their product, users, and help drive key strategic decisions Establish a clear product vision and connect the dots across functions and organizations Communicate roadmaps, decisions, and learnings across a wide range of audiences from development teams to executives Lead full product and feature development cycles from discovery to delivery Qualifications 5+ years of product management experience Proven ability to thrive within ambiguity by applying a mix of research, analytics, intuition, and empathy to tackle problems Experience taking multiple products/feature sets through the entire development life cycle, from ideation to launch Clear and structured communicator, can turn big ideas into actionable roadmaps with clear goals and align multiple levels of stakeholders Excited about solving complex problems, building innovative products, and learning alongside a world-class team What we offer Our salary range for this role is $160,000- $200,000 USD per year.

We determine individual offers based on your skills and experience, what similar roles pay at comparable companies, and cost-of-living differences by location.

Remote work with flexible hours and a budget to set up your work space Localized healthcare coverage designed to support you and your family’s well-being Flexible paid time off with a 3-week minimum (not including holidays) to support your well-being Company-wide "no internal meetings" Fridays to help you focus on deep, uninterrupted work Professional growth budget for any form of self-improvement: specialized technical training, conferences, certifications or even foreign language courses Monthly health & wellness allowance to spend on whatever keeps you physically and mentally at your best Annual offsites where we gather in person to build meaningful connections with your fellow Fluxon ians Profit-sharing program for you to benefit directly from our collective growth and success Paid sabbatical program to reset, recharge, and gain a fresh perspective A competitive salary that reflects your expertise and experience We believe diverse teams perform better, and an inclusive environment is essential to building a successful organization.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing accommodations throughout the hiring process. This role may use AI-assisted tools to support initial screening. All assessments and decisions are made by a human reviewer. Originally posted on Himalayas

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

At Nebius, we’re building a next-generation AI compute platform for large-scale ML training and inference — from a few nodes to thousands of GPUs.

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to own product direction for Soperator — our Slurm-on-Kubernetes control plane for GPU clusters.

In this role, you will shape how ML engineers and research teams run, scale, and optimize distributed workloads in production.

If you care about systems that combine performance, reliability, and developer experience at the frontier of AI infrastructure, this role is for you.

· Own the full user journey across Soperator clusters: Slurm workflows, dashboards, alerts/notifications, node lifecycle, and training/inference capacity management.

· Define product direction end-to-end: problem discovery → solution design → delivery → adoption .

· Lead deep customer discovery through interviews, usage analytics, and workload analysis to uncover high-impact opportunities.

· Drive execution across platform teams: compute, networking, storage, observability, IAM and etc.

· Translate frontier ML and infrastructure ideas into practical product capabilities for real-world GPU clusters.

· Define success metrics, prioritize roadmap decisions with data, and ensure measurable customer/business impact.

· Lead the open-source strategy and execution for Soperator: shape public roadmap themes, prioritize OSS-facing capabilities, and ensure strong adoption in the community.

· 3–5+ years in Product Management, ML infrastructure/MLOps, distributed systems, or cloud platform engineering.

· Strong technical depth in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or ML platforms.

· Hands-on familiarity with large-scale ML training and orchestration tools (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray ).

· Track record of shipping technically complex products with multiple engineering teams.

· Strong communication and stakeholder management across engineering, research, and customers.

· Experience with product analytics, data-informed prioritization, and experimentation.

· High ownership, high learning velocity, and comfort operating in fast-moving AI infrastructure environments.

s.h: It will be an added bonus if you have
s.t:
· Experience with GPU platforms and HPC primitives: InfiniBand/RDMA, topology-aware scheduling , high-throughput storage.

· Practical understanding of modern ML training stacks: PyTorch, DeepSpeed, FSDP/ZeRO, NCCL .

· Familiarity with efficiency and reliability metrics: Goodput, MFU, failure modes, preemption handling, health checks .

· Exposure to large-scale LLM training/inference systems.

· Experience in observability, performance tuning, or SRE/reliability engineering.

· Customer-facing technical experience (solutioning, support, architecture advisory).

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training.

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East.

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware.

This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day.

· Competitive compensation

· Collaborative and innovative culture

· International environment and talented teams

s.t: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Die campoint AG ist Technologiepartner und Betreiber einer der größten deutschsprachigen Plattformen für die Creator Economy und Digital Entertainment - von der Consumer-Plattform bis zur B2B-Infrastruktur, mit der Creators und Agenturen ihr Business aufbauen und steuern.

Dabei sind Creators für uns keine User, sondern Unternehmer, deren Erfolg unmittelbar von unseren Produkten abhängt. Das bestimmt, wie wir priorisieren. Wir gestalten nach unserer Vision. Wir leben von Teamplay, Hands-on-Mentalität und einer Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.
Aufgaben
Du bekommst echte Ownership für zugewiesene Produkt-Streams innerhalb unseres B2B-Portfolios. Das bedeutet: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was nicht - auf Basis von Creator-Feedback, Umsatzdaten und strategischem Rahmen. Wir haben keine langen Abstimmungsrunden. Du bist das Quality-Gateway für Dein Team und Eure Releases.
Du navigierst eigenständig durch ein komplexes Stakeholder-Umfeld. Wir erwarten, dass Du Konflikte direkt löst - nicht eskalierst.
Die strategische Richtung gibt der Head of Product vor. Deine Aufgabe ist es, sie mit hoher Eigenständigkeit und Qualitätsanspruch umzusetzen und innerhalb Deiner Streams bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen, als wenn er sie selbst treffen würde.
Das ist kein Stepping-Stone in die Produktstrategie. Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der im Operativen exzellent ist und das als Stärke sieht, nicht als Einschränkung.
Du verantwortest Discovery, Priorisierung und Delivery in Deinen Produkt-Streams von Anfang bis Ende.
Du übersetzt qualitative Creator-Insights und starke Signale direkt in mutige Entscheidungen - ohne Dich in endlosen Datenanalysen ("Analysis Paralysis") zu verlieren.
Du schreibst klare Specs und Tickets, die ohne Nacharbeit ins Development gehen.
Du erkennst, wann ein Prozess oder Sprint-Ritual der schnellen Problemlösung im Weg steht, und brichst es pragmatisch in Absprache mit dem Team auf.
Du holst externe Impulse aktiv rein und arbeitest sie pragmatisch ein.

Define the Vision: Shape the long-term strategy and roadmap for Reddit’s Ads ML platform, ensuring we are adopting cutting-edge technologies (including Generative AI and LLM workflows) to stay ahead of the curve.

s.t:
Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013.

We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin.

For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.
We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.
Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 350 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators.

Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own product delivery across complex Higher Education engagements. This role is ideal for an experienced product thinker who can run a backlog, translate business needs into clear requirements, and build strong relationships with clients and delivery teams from day one.
In this role, you will work as a core member of a cross-functional delivery team, owning backlog management, requirements definition, and sprint execution end-to-end. You'll be joining real, in-flight work where quality and delivery speed matter, collaborating with experienced engineers and designers and growing the product instincts that come from shipping things that matter.
Why This Role Matters
Product Managers are how Robots and Pencils turns requirements into shipped work. On the engagements you support, you own the backlog, translate business needs into clear user stories, and keep the team's day-to-day delivery moving. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days; that pace holds only when someone treats the backlog like their own, keeps the team unblocked, and asks the right question before the team builds the wrong thing.

Craft & Delivery
Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring work is clearly defined, prioritized, and aligned to business outcomes
Translate business needs and stakeholder requests into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
Partner with engineering and design to ensure requirements are well understood and delivered with quality
Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and day-to-day delivery execution to keep the team on track
Identify and manage dependencies, risks, and scope changes throughout the delivery lifecycle
Leverage data, user feedback, and team insights to continuously improve the product
Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to accelerate documentation, research, and analysis
Collaboration & Communication
Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, serving as a trusted partner in delivery
Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Facilitate working sessions, requirement discussions, and decision-making forums with clients and delivery teams
Leadership & Influence
Own the outcome of the work, not just the tickets — care about what shipped well, not just what got built
Frame requests in terms of user and business outcomes, not just features
Contribute to a positive, high-performing team environment through reliability, clarity, and good judgment

5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership
Experience in the Higher Education space including Colleague ERP, SIS, and LMS platforms
Strong understanding of agile delivery practices and product ownership responsibilities
Experience writing requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for cross-functional delivery teams
Experience working directly with clients or external stakeholders
Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences
Analytical approach to decision-making using data and user insight
Proficiency with product and delivery tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Miro)
Demonstrable usage of AI tools to accelerate documentation, research, and analysis (e.g., Claude)
Experience in a consulting or agency environment is a plus
Helpful Extras and Unique Skills
Curiosity about prototyping with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) — willingness to try AI to validate product ideas, even if you haven't done it formally yet.
Experience with process-mapping or documentation tools.
Working familiarity with GenAI fundamentals (LLMs, prompt engineering) — enough to follow technical conversations and ask good questions.
Exposure to AI-powered products as a user, contributor, or observer, and the curiosity to learn how they're built.
Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing.
You’ll Do Well Here if You Are
A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.
Honest about what you don’t know. You name the assumption, separate customer truth from client opinion, and AI promise from AI reality. You’d rather slow the room down for the right question than rush to the wrong answer.

### **V-ZUG Procurement** ###
Der Bereich Procurement verantwortet die strategische Beschaffung von Materialien, Komponenten und Dienstleistungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Als Schweizer Premiumhersteller mit eigener Produktion am Hauptsitz in Zug stellen wir hohe Anforderungen an unsere Lieferanten - und an uns selbst.

Unser Einkauf ist entsprechend professionell aufgestellt: mit klaren Kategorienstrukturen, einem internationalen Lieferantennetzwerk und dem Anspruch, nicht nur Kosten zu optimieren, sondern Partnerschaften zu gestalten, die langfristig tragen.
### **Das bietet dir die Stelle** ###
* Du entwickelst und setzt die Warengruppen- und Lieferantenstrategie für deine Kategorien um - nicht als Verwaltungsaufgabe, sondern als echte Gestaltungsaufgabe: Du entscheidest, welche Lieferanten V-ZUG langfristig begleiten, wo neue Quellen erschlossen werden und wie die Materialversorgung auch in einem volatilen Markt stabil bleibt
* Du steuerst dein Lieferantenportfolio über den gesamten Lebenszyklus - von der Auswahl neuer Partner über gezielte Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ausphasung. Gemeinsam mit dem Supplier Quality Management sorgst du dafür, dass Anspruch und Realität übereinstimmen - durch regelmässige Bewertungen und Audits, die mehr sind als ein Pflichtprogramm
* Du verantwortest das Vertragsmanagement in deinen zugewiesenen Warengruppen im Bereich Mechanik - von der Erstellung über die Verhandlung bis zur laufenden Pflege. Du weisst, was in einem Vertrag wirklich zählt, und bringst interne Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Nenner
* Du führst Ausschreibungen durch, vergleichst Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen fundierte Vergabeempfehlungen und Entscheidungen, die wirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen optimal vereinen
* Du hast die Kostenentwicklung deiner Vorserien- und Serienartikel im Griff: Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, nutzt sie konsequent und setzt Massnahmen um, die nachhaltig wirken
* Du bist fester Bestandteil von Projekten, koordinierst Materialbedarfe mit Lieferanten und stellst sicher, dass Muster, Prototypen und Serienmaterialien dann da sind, wenn sie gebraucht werden
### **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit** ###
* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Supply Chain Management oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin
* Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Einkauf mit und weisst, wie man Lieferanten gegenüber souverän Position bezieht - mit Verhandlungsgeschick, das nicht laut sein muss, um zu wirken, und einer Kommunikation, die intern wie extern ankommt
* Du denkst strategisch und analytisch: Du erkennst Marktdynamiken, leitest daraus konkrete Massnahmen ab und entwickelst Einkaufsstrategien, die nicht nur für heute, sondern für morgen tragen
* Du weisst, wofür du stehst und bringst die Klarheit, Durchsetzungsstärke und Überzeugungskraft mit, um das auch zu zeigen: im internen Projektumfeld genauso wie im Gespräch mit externen Partnern
* Der sichere Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, insbesondere SAP, sowie digitalen Tools ist für dich selbstverständlich - kein Aufwand, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage
* Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - schriftlich wie mündlich, klar und mit dem richtigen Gespür dafür, was dein Gegenüber braucht

An Introduction to Primer
Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.
Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Read up on our $100m Series C

Which team will you be joining?
Getting paid is only half the story. Understanding and managing those payments is where the real work begins.
In the Financial Operations team we build the tools and infrastructure that let merchants take control of their payments: reconciling funds, monitoring performance, and automating the operations that keep everything running. We also own Global Accounts, giving merchants the ability to hold, manage and move funds across currencies and markets, a foundational capability as Primer expands into more complex, cross-border payment environments.
The team spans Reconciliation, Operations Automation, Global Accounts and FX. As a Product Manager here you will own a sub-area within that: a coherent slice of the product where you own the problems, the prioritisation and the outcomes over multiple quarters.
You will work day to day with a dedicated engineering team and design partner, alongside GTM, and report into the Product lead for the area. Primer is remote-first and globally distributed, and always will be. We run on written thinking, low bureaucracy and real ownership. You build it, you own it, end to end.
What will you be doing?
Owning the outcomes for your sub-area of Financial Operations over multiple quarters, not just shipping a backlog
Defining the problems worth solving in your scope by synthesising merchant feedback, support data, competitive moves and platform constraints
Planning and delivering initiatives independently, making real-time trade-offs on scope, sequencing and quality to protect both timelines and outcomes
Writing specs that anticipate the edge cases that actually matter in payments operations: reconciliation breaks, currency and settlement complexity
Partnering closely with engineering on feasibility and technical trade-offs, and defining the leading and lagging metrics that tell you whether your sub-area is working
Owning launch readiness and driving rapid post-launch iteration based on what the data shows
Representing your sub-area to merchants and internal stakeholders, turning operational complexity into clear product decisions

A track record of owning a product sub-area or significant feature set end to end, with outcomes that can be traced back to your decisions
The ability to define problems independently from messy inputs, rather than waiting for a fully formed brief
Sound, autonomous trade-offs on scope, quality and technical debt within your scope
Enough technical fluency to partner with engineers on feasibility and integration implications, not just hand over requirements
Clear, structured communication that keeps engineering, design and GTM aligned and surfaces risks early

Experience in payments, fintech, or operational and back-office product such as reconciliation, ledgers, treasury or FX
Comfort with data analysis to define and track outcome metrics
You may not like it here
Financial operations is detail-heavy and unforgiving. Reconciliation and FX have real money and real edge cases attached. If you prefer broad, abstract product work to getting the details exactly right, this will frustrate you.
You are expected to define what is worth solving in your sub-area, with support rather than direction.
We are remote-first and async by default. If you need people physically around you to do your best work, this is a real adjustment, not a perk.
Feedback here is direct and frequent. You are expected to give it as well as take it.

About Manifest
Manifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.
Our customers run real-world businesses: tours, attractions, experiences, rentals, and activities. They need software that helps them sell more, operate smoothly, and deliver great guest experiences.
We're building a B2B2C SaaS platform that brings booking, ecommerce, payments, accounting, operations, and customer experience together in a modern architecture. The product surface is broad, the workflows are nuanced, and the opportunity is big.

That surface now spans several distinct product areas, including a newer, AI-native platform for building and delivering customer websites end-to-end. We're hiring more than one Senior Product Manager, and we'll match each hire to the area where their strengths fit best, from established features to fast-moving, zero-to-one greenfield work.
We're looking for Senior Product Managers to own product direction, roadmap, and prioritization for one or more key areas of Manifest.
This is not a backlog management role. We're looking for someone who can take ambiguous customer and business problems, find the shape of the opportunity, make smart tradeoffs, and help a cross-functional team ship high-quality product experiences.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll turn customer insight, business context, and technical possibilities into clear product direction and own the delivery end-to-end.
Modern product work is changing, and this role reflects that. We expect our PMs to be fluent and genuinely enthusiastic users of AI-assisted tools—using Claude, Cursor, v0, and similar tools to explore interactions, build lightweight prototypes, and make product ideas concrete before implementation begins. On some of our teams, AI-native workflows are not just a way of working faster; they're central to the product itself.
You'll work closely with Product leadership, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and design-minded front-end engineers. Depending on the area you own, there may not be a dedicated product designer, so you should be comfortable playing an active role in shaping user workflows, interaction patterns, and overall product quality.
You'll also be the bridge between executive vision and execution: taking high-level direction set by our leadership team and honing it into concrete, buildable product requirements. Leadership helps frame the why and the what, but you own the product decisions about what to build and how to bring it to life.
You do not need to be a front-end engineer, and you won't be expected to write production code. But strong technical fluency is a real advantage—enough to collaborate deeply with engineers on UI-heavy, technically nuanced product areas, and to understand the systems you're shaping. A technical or former engineering background is strongly preferred.
You should also be comfortable owning the delivery side of the work, along with the product vision, like milestones, sequencing, and keeping a small team moving.

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth, not comfort.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.
We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.
Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users.

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.
What You’ll Own: Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.
What Success Looks Like: You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.
What You Bring Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

The accountant is the lead persona for this role. Bookkeepers, controllers, fractional CFOs, and outside CPAs are the people who actually live in this software day to day. Build for them and the owner wins by default. Build only for the owner and the accountant works around you, which means you lose.
The reason this role exists at Flex and not at every fintech is the unique customer we serve.

Super premium business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue have a controller or an outside accountant, real ERP systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, sometimes Microsoft Dynamics or Acumatica), and a layered financial life where the business and personal sides are deeply intertwined.

The owner pays themselves a distribution, then funds personal investments, then pays for an asset, then expenses something back through the company. Their accountant has to make all of it tie out. We are the only product positioned to make that integrated life elegant for both sides. This role builds it.
You will not build a generic accounting integration. You will build the Accountants Stack that bookkeepers, controllers, and CPAs actually want, which means knowing what they hate about QuickBooks, what they love about NetSuite, what they wish Bill.com did, and where the seams between business and personal finance create the most friction today.

----------------
Define the strategy and own the connectivity layer to the accounting and ERP systems our customers' accountants use. QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, etc.
Build expense management that works for owners and the accountants reconciling on their behalf. Receipt capture, GL coding, approval workflows, integration into the accounting tools without requiring manual reconciliation downstream.
Own bill pay and AR/AP. The workflow from invoice received to vendor paid, from invoice sent to customer paid, with full reconciliation back to the accounting system.
Build the invoicing product. We do not have a real invoicing offering today and customers are starting to ask. Decide what shape it takes and ship it.
Architect the connection between business financial data and personal financial data. This is the wedge no other fintech has. Make the integrated owner life real in product so the accountant can deliver it cleanly.
Partner closely with the Banking, Credit, Cards, and Payments product owners so financial flows tie out cleanly across the stack. No seams. No reconciliation tax for the accountant or the customer.
Translate the controller, CFO, and CPA persona for the rest of the company. We need someone who speaks both owner and accountant fluently. And can translate it to the owner mindset.
What you will need
------------------
You have spent years thinking about how business owners and the accountants who serve them actually run financial operations. You know the difference between a bookkeeper, a controller, a fractional CFO, and an outside accountant, and you have built product for at least one of them.
Deep, hands-on familiarity with at least two of: QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Acumatica. Not "I know they exist." Actually built in or integrated to them at depth.
You can journal a transaction without looking it up. You understand accrual versus cash basis, the close cycle, what a 1099 is for, and why a controller cares about the audit trail.
You have built either inside an accounting platform, on top of one as an integration partner, or built a fintech product that lives natively in the accounting workflow.
You understand the accountant channel and how CPAs influence product adoption. Bonus if you have built for or partnered with CPAs directly.
Typically 4 to 10 years of experience. Title is not the point.

Additional Information
We want to hear from you. We value passion, determination, and honesty. If you do not match every line of the spec but you can show us the work, apply anyway. Unusual paths and rare skills are how you stand out at Flex.

Anyone can build AI insurance software now. The models are commoditized. The demos work. Almost nobody starts where Agency Revolution starts: thousands of independent P&C agencies already paying us to communicate with their clients, plus deep integrations into the systems where agency data actually lives.
The opportunity is the relationship layer — the system that notices when an agency's clients are at risk of churning, spots the cross-sell opportunity, picks the right message and channel and moment, and acts. We call it RelationshipOS. For ten years, agencies have trusted us to speak to their clients.

Now we're expanding what we can see: call transcripts, carrier communications, life events. The policies live in the agency's management system. The relationship lives with us. Nobody else has both the permission and the infrastructure.
We know what we're betting on. We don't yet know what makes an agency owner act on it. That's the job.
The strategic thesis is set. What's unresolved is whether it's true — whether an agency will actually change what they do because our system told them to, and what has to be built for that to happen. You're hired to answer that by shipping, not by studying.

s.h: Two halves, and you need both
s.t:
You personally build the bet. The intelligence layer is your work. Discovery with agency owners, prototypes in front of them within days, the smallest version that proves someone will act. Much of this is assembled rather than authored — the right vendor wired into AR Connect and pointed at a real use case will beat anything we could build from scratch this year. You don't hand this half to your team; it's too early and too ambiguous to delegate.
Your team drives the day-to-day execution and health of the existing platform. Two Product Owners and a Product Analyst keep a profitable, decade-old product healthy and improving. You set their priorities, strengthen their product judgment, raise their craft, and shield them from thrash. You remain the primary product manager responsible for the roadmap, discovery, and strategic product decisions. Done well, this is what buys you the time to do the first half.
Most people are good at one of these. We need someone who won't quietly abandon the other.
This position offers $125,000-$140,000 depending on experience and qualifications.

RelationshipOS — the intelligence layer. Churn signals. Cross-sell opportunities. Adaptive customer journeys instead of rigid sequences. You define what "acted on" means, instrument it, and are accountable for the number.
AR Connect and the vendor stack. AR Connect is our integration layer — where APIs pull in calls, carrier communications, life events, and other signals, and where third-party capability plugs into our distribution. It's the substrate the whole thesis sits on, and it's how a promising vendor becomes a live use case in front of agencies.
That work is yours: mapping the landscape of management systems, carrier connections, data enrichment providers, and AI vendors; deciding what we integrate versus build; running the POCs; and getting from "interesting demo" to something an agency actually uses. Data quality, latency, unit economics, and what happens when a vendor's model is wrong are your problems to surface early. You shape the deals and bring the recommendation — the SVP and our partnership team close them.
Voice AI as a channel. Not a feature — a real channel. Define the MVP, run pilots where AI handles outbound outreach with warm handoffs to agencies, and produce the evidence for whether this moves us from subscription toward outcome-based pricing.
The Agency Revolution roadmap. What ships, in what order, and what we stop doing. You own the sequencing and defend it.

This role starts on the content platform, and the platform surface it serves is growing. The foundations of the company, identity and access, developer platform, data and the infrastructure everything runs on, are being invested in over the coming year. We are looking for someone whose curiosity does not stop at the edge of their own team, because the interesting problems here sit exactly where those layers meet.
There is genuine ambiguity in this space right now, and a decision or two you would inherit that we have not finished making. We would rather tell you that than have you discover it in month two. The upside is that very little here is set, so the person who takes this shapes the layer everything else in the product is built on for the next several years.

Own the content services every surface depends on. The services and APIs that serve content to the learner surface, the admin surface and everything we build next, plus the delivery path including CDN and video, and file and asset storage.
Own the structural contract. How content is stored, versioned and served so it can be reused and assembled differently for different customers. This is a schema and interface problem before it is a tooling problem, and your measure is whether the contract other teams build against is clear, stable and safe to change.
Own multi tenant separation. Making sure one customer’s content and branding stay theirs. The tenancy model needs a decision and an owner, and that will be one of your first real pieces of work.
Own access, entitlements and data residency. Who can reach what, where data lives, and what we are able to commit to contractually.
Own performance and cost per tenant. If this layer is slow, everything is slow. If it is expensive, it is expensive everywhere.
Carry the platform half of a migration already in flight. We are moving off an incumbent content tool while the current system keeps earning. Sequencing that is the real work, and the order matters more than the ambition.
Own the non functional questions that show up in deals. A meaningful share of our deals slow down in security and compliance review rather than in the pitch, and that is a product problem with a revenue number attached.

s.h: This role is for you if you have
s.t:
Experience with content management as a product, whether that is a CMS, a DAM, a headless content platform or a structured content system at scale. This is our primary preference.
Experience owning platform or infrastructure adjacent product, where success was measured in what other teams could build rather than in features a customer names.
Enough technical depth to be useful and the honesty to say where you are not. You can read an architecture proposal, ask the question that unpicks it, and tell the difference between a researched answer and a fluent one.
The ability to hold your own with senior engineers, infrastructure engineers and security specialists. Not as a peer on implementation, but well enough that a remediation estimate or a tenancy design does not go unchallenged. A previous career as an engineer is a real advantage and not a requirement.
A habit of thinking in seams. Where systems meet, what a contract between them should guarantee, and how to keep a decision reversible rather than walking through a one way door.
The ability to sequence. We are modernising a platform that carries real history while it keeps earning, and the order matters more than the ambition.
Writing. Decisions, tradeoffs and the reasoning behind them, in a way an engineer and an executive can both act on.
Nice to have, and genuinely useful: depth in AI and personalisation, or in infrastructure. Either one compounds with this role, and we are not expecting both.

s.h: This role is not for you if
s.t:
You want to be a delivery manager for the engineers. They are strong and they do not need coordinating. They need decisions and clarity about what matters.
You want to own the authoring and editorial experience itself. A colleague owns that, you will work closely with them, and drawing the seam between you well is part of the job.
You want to run a rewrite programme. Foundations serve outcomes, and a foundation with no customer outcome attached does not get funded here and should not.
You need the surrounding decisions settled before you arrive.
